This would require allowing to download avatars from users who are not in the same instance as you, which has security implications. Besides the obvious implication of allowing to download private avatars of users you're not in the instance with, it would allow the user list of every discoverable instance (you're permitted to enter) to be scraped without being there, even if there are users on "Ask Me" or "Do Not Disturb" statuses hiding their location. It would also require checks in place to see if you're allowed to enter the travel destination you've requested first, which can also change during queueing to a travel destination.

Even if this was permitted, you'd still have a shader compilation step and you'd likely need to run the live synced network state for animators on demand for all shaders to be compiled memory efficiently, where loading a material may cause a stutter.

The issue of "lagging out" seems to be generally a non-issue with Poor or better ranked avatars in full 80/80 instances with PCVR, from my experience. The options already exist to make your experience comfortable, no matter what.

details: For big gatherings, like clubs, group meet ups etc. it would add to the smoothness of the VR experience if there was an option you can toggle to pre-download and then -load all avatars for an instance together with the world (a separate loading bar indicating that avatars are being downloaded right after loading the world for example). If you spend most of your time lagging out extremely after joining a world while loading every avatar this time isn't spent in any meaningful way other than the screen freezing every couple seconds and not being able to communicate until everyone is loaded in. Avatar culling etc. does help quite a bit in a lot of cases, but sometimes it can be hard to tell in advance if people are close to spawn or if they are somewhere much further away, making avatar culling potentially less effective in cases like that and depending on how far the cusotm-set avatar culing option reaches. I know that a feature like this would increase download time drastically, but if you end up downloading these avatars anyway and while they are being downloaded the game is just lagging, there is no point in not having the option to pre-download them before joining a world.
title: Option: Pre-download and -load avatars before entering a world
